ae2s-appliedpneumatics.ponder.shared.air: Power the ME network and provide channels. Put an air storage cell in the drive.
An import bus facing a compressor imports compressed air. Select the air resource type in the bus.
Connect the pressure interface to tubes and set its target in bar. It exchanges air with ME storage to hold that pressure.
Fit security cards to protect full cells. Vacuum cards void overflow in cells and unlock negative pressure in interfaces.
Portable cells are 20 bar when full. Charge them in a PNC charging station or the interface's item slot; a charging card supplies carried pneumatic tools.
Attune an ME P2P with a pressure tube, then link its input and outputs with an AE2S memory card. Air follows pressure differences.
ae2s-appliedpneumatics.ponder.shared.hea: Connect the temperature interface to your machine. Use the original +/- buttons to set the target in Celsius; hold Shift for tenfold steps.
Supply stored air and AE energy. Temperature control consumes both; speed cards increase the rate and volume cards increase heat capacity.
Attune a P2P with a blaze rod and link it with a memory card to distribute heat to distant machines.
ae2s-appliedpneumatics.ponder.shared.tra: Connect the processing station to a powered ME network with item/fluid storage and a crafting CPU. Leave the sky above it clear for drones.
Charge the wireless terminal, then sneak-use it on the station to bind it. Open it to browse and search the server's real Amadron offers.
Right-click offer cards to add trades to the basket, then press Submit. Payment comes from ME storage; PNC drones collect and deliver it.
Put AE2S blank patterns into the terminal slot. Select an unlimited offer and click the arrow to encode it, then put that pattern in the station.
Request the traded output through AE2S crafting. The station offers its patterns to the CPU, orders the trade, and returns deliveries to the same ME network.
ae2s-appliedpneumatics.ponder.tag.pneuma: Air, temperature and Amadron automation with AE2S.
